mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDPC1 growth > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for three consecutive months signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE < 3.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.2% in the same month signals a successful disinflationary tightening, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls by > 0.2% in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL fall by > 0.2% in same month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of RSAFS monthly change < -1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 signals robust labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of PAYEMS monthly change > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) of more than 5% signals a recovery in residential construction, which boosts materials and homebuilding sector earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of HOUST monthly change > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
